description: Sähköistetyt saaret 2005 is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Turun yliopisto. Saariston sähköistämistä kuvaava kartta sisältää tiedon sekä muuntamosähkön että merikaapeliyhteyden avulla sähköistetyistä saarista Saaristomerellä. Coverage: Turun yliopisto. The publisher named on the listing is Turun yliopisto. Its keywords include Yhteiskunta, Varsinais-Suomi, Ei-Inspire, Merialueet, avoindata.fi, Alueellinen. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
